_comment: Editable step content for the guided tour. Each step's 'id' must match a wiring entry in MainWindow._tutorial_step_wiring() (that map owns the target widget + tab-switch action; this file owns the user-facing copy). Reorder this array to change tour order; remove an entry to skip it; add a new id here + a matching wiring entry to add a step. Allowed preferred_side values: above, below, left, right, auto.

steps.title: Welcome to Smart Citizen
steps.description: This quick tour covers the core workflow of customizing strings and applying the result back to Star Citizen. Many of these steps run automatically, but can be done manually if needed. You can skip anytime.

steps.title: 1. Extract from Data.p4k
steps.description: Clicking Extract unpacks your installed game's stock localization file. You should be prompted to run this if your current file becomes stale due to a patch, but if not, you can always run it manually. The strings reload into the table automatically when extraction finishes.

steps.title: 2. Enhancements
steps.description: Optional but recommended: the Enhancements tab toggles stat overlays for ships, components, weapons, mission blueprints/rewards, and commodity crafting. Generate Enhancements runs the pipeline that produces those overlays from your extracted data. The next few steps walk through the individual sections of this tab.

steps.title: 3. Enhancements: Categories
steps.description: Toggle which enhancement categories run when you Generate. Ships, components, ship weapons, FPS weapons, missions, mission rewards, commodity crafting, and medical consumables can each be enabled independently.

steps.title: 4. Enhancements: Favorites
steps.description: Pick the prefix character prepended to favorited ship names so they sort to the top of the in-game ASOP terminal. Default is *.

steps.title: 5. Enhancements: Mission Labels
steps.description: Customize the section headers (MISSION DETAILS / POTENTIAL BLUEPRINTS / ITEM REWARDS / BLUEPRINT DATA), the XP label shown on missions without a specific reputation rank (default Rep), and the emphasis tag (EM3 = underline, EM4 = color) for headers.

steps.title: 6. Enhancements: Tag Builder
steps.description: Build the bracketed name tags added to components, missiles, ship weapons, commodities, and armor. Reorder elements with ▲/▼, untick to exclude, change abbreviation length, pick separator and brackets, or place the tag after the name instead of before.

steps.title: 7. Blueprint Tracker
steps.description: Mark the blueprints you own. Search the left list by name or mission, or narrow it by component Type, Class, Size, and Grade, then use the arrows to move items to your owned list. Owned blueprints get an [Owned] tag wherever they show up in a mission's potential rewards, so you can tell at a glance what's worth chasing.

steps.title: 8. Edit strings
steps.description: Each row is one localization record. Double-click a cell in the Custom Value column to edit — your changes are autosaved. The ★ column marks ships as favorites so they sort to the top of the ASOP.

steps.title: 9. Filter by column
steps.description: The row of search boxes under the column headers filters the table as you type. Each box scopes to its own column (Key, Default Value, Current Value, Custom Value); filters across columns combine with AND. Click the × inside a box to clear it.

steps.title: 10. Editor pane
steps.description: For longer strings click Editor to open a side-docked editing canvas with more room. The pane follows the row you select; right-click selected text for Underline / Highlight emphasis. Drag the title bar to undock it into a free-floating window.

steps.title: 11. Preview pane
steps.description: Whenever you select a row, this pane on the right shows the rendered text of its current value.

steps.title: 12. Apply Enhancements
steps.description: Apply writes the merged result to the game's global.ini. A timestamped backup of the current global.ini is created first (up to 5 are kept, restorable from Restore Backup).

steps.title: 13. Config: Appearance
steps.description: Pick the app theme (Default / Light / Dark / ODW) and optionally disable the auto-tour on new versions.

steps.title: 14. Config: Star Citizen Installation
steps.description: Path to your Star Citizen install root (the directory containing LIVE, PTU, EPTU, etc.). Auto-detected at install time; edit here if your game lives elsewhere. The Channel dropdown picks which channel the app reads and writes, and the Language dropdown switches both the app's UI and the game strings.

steps.title: 15. Config: Smart Citizen Data
steps.description: Where user.ini, caches, DataForge extraction, generated enhancement INIs, and backups live. Defaults to Documents\Smart Citizen; move it off OneDrive if extraction or cache cleanup is slow.

steps.title: 16. Config: Base Localization
steps.description: The Extract from Data.p4k button lives here. This is the sole source for base strings and enhancement data — re-run it after game patches to refresh.

steps.title: 17. Config: Tools
steps.description: Import an external INI into your overrides via the conflict-resolution dialog, or reset your user.ini for the active channel (auto-backed-up before clearing).

steps.title: 18. Help & feedback
steps.description: The Help button opens a side-panel with the full guide, a Known Issues list, and a feedback link to the Smart Citizen Discord channel. That's everything you need to get started — good luck, citizen.
